units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 18:20">Targ. Jer. XVIII, 20</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 18:22">22</cite> (ed. Lag. a. oth. <cite ref="Q00473"><he>פְּחֵית</he></cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="Q00493"><he>פַּחֲתִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 14:37">Targ. O. Lev. XIV, 37</cite> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <cite ref="Q00491"><he>פַּחֲתָן</he></cite>; h. text <he>שקערורת</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 70a:3">B. Mets. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>שקיל אגרא ושקיל פ׳</he> he charged a compensation for the use of the vessel, and an indemnity for the loss (by wear and tear).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 70a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אי אגרא לא פ׳ ואי פ׳ לא אגרא</he> if you take payment for the use of the vessel, you must not charge for wear and tear &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:4:4">Y. Ned. IX, end, 41ᶜ</cite> <he>תהא פַּחֲתָה בה</he> let a decrease come over it (may his wealth be reduced).
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite> <he>איזיל לפ׳</he> go to ruin!
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 9:18">Gen. IX, 18</cite> <he>אבי כנען</he>) <he>אבוי דפ׳</he> the father of the degraded.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 49:5">Gen. XLIX, 5</cite>) <he>אחים דפ׳ וכ׳</he> ‘brothers’ of the degraded (Dinah, with ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 34:25">Gen. XXXIV, 25</cite>) …, but no brothers to Joseph.
